{{Quote|Hey, that's the same drink Bren-Nevin Rordan orders&mdash;you know, from the northwest shop area. He always comes in, buys one and says 'I've got your package' as he drinks it. That will be 2 credits.|The bartender, covertly informing a group of Bren-Nevin Rordan's whereabouts|<ref name="DenofSpies" />}}
A '''bartender''' worked at the [[SaSassis Bar]], a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]] in [[Verena City]]'s [[Verena Starport]],<ref name="DenofSpies" /> around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="DenofSpiesDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The "[[Den of Spies]]" adventure of [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']] states that Bren-Jules Rordan has been on assignment for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the Battle of Endor. As such, the events of "Den of Spies" must occur around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].</ref> At some point, they became associated with the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]. The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] was seedy looking.<ref name="DenofSpies" />

{{RPGseed}}
While working at the bar, the bartender encountered a group of travelers attempting to smuggle a [[modular command circuit]] to [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Intelligence Service [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Bren-Nevin Rordan]]. When given the correct code&mdash;a request for a [[Corellian Twister]] with "no twist"&mdash;the bartender informed the group of Rordan's location through code, stating he was at [[Rordan's Galactic Exotic Art]] in the [[City/Legends|city's]] northwest shop area. Continuing the guise of actually serving the requested [[Alcohol/Legends|beverage]], the bartender charged the group two [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DenofSpies" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The bartender was created by [[Richard Clark]], [[Barbara Clark]], and [[Janelle Keberle]] and introduced in "[[Den of Spies]]," an adventure in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Players have the chance of never meeting the bartender, with the gamemaster being given the opportunity to deem their actions upon arriving on Kirima "stupid," resulting in the party's apprehension by [[New Republic Customs]].<ref name="DenofSpies" />
